In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref>, during the [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between the [[Quesoth]] and [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s forces and the [[Empire of the Hand]], Imperial [[Stromma contingent]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Lhagva]] compared the [[A-frame]] vehicles found within [[Gender/Legends|his]] home '''city's''' [[Clothing/Legends|garment]] district with the [[A-rack]]s used during the battle.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city was mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
